body_lead: Patna, July 4, 2025 – In a landmark move to preserve linguistic heritage and enhance public access to historical records, the Government of Bihar, through its Revenue & Land Reforms Department, signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Digital India BHASHINI Division (DIBD) under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY).
